# Fields of an activity

Every activity, wherever it appears (`all`, `item`, `filter`, `tag`), has exactly these fields.
Paths use dots for nested objects and `[]` for items inside a list.

| Field | Type | Allowed values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Stable identifier, prefixed by the directory it came from (e.g. `engsoc-qset`, `ams-youreka-kingston`). Use it with `item/{id}.json`. |
| `api_version` | string | `1` | API version this record belongs to. |
| `school` | string |  | School id, e.g. `queens`. |
| `name` | string |  | Name as published by the activity's directory. |
| `type` | string | `club`, `team`, `design-team`, `discipline-club`, `committee`, `conference`, `competition` | What kind of activity it is. Every value is explained in filters.md. |
| `faculty` | string | `arts-science`, `business`, `education`, `engineering`, `general`, `graduate`, `health-sciences`, `law` | Faculty that runs it, or `general` when it is open to students from any faculty. |
| `subfaculty` | string or null |  | Programme or school inside the faculty, e.g. `civil-engineering`, `computing`, `commerce`. null when it is faculty-wide. Valid values per faculty are listed in filters.md. |
| `applications_open` | boolean or null |  | true while applications are being accepted; false when its recruitment board is active but shows nothing for it; null when unknown. |
| `application_deadline` | string or null |  | When applications close: a date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `rolling` when it's always open (join or drop by any time, no application window). null when unknown. |
| `eligibility` | object |  | Who can join. |
| `eligibility.first_year` | string or null | `focused`, `friendly`, `no` | Whether first-year students can take part. `focused`: made specifically for first-years. `friendly`: first-years can join. `no`: not open to first-years. null: the source doesn't say. |
| `eligibility.first_year_friendly` | boolean or null |  | `first_year` as a boolean: true for focused or friendly, false for no, null when unknown. |
| `eligibility.years` | array of integers or null |  | Undergraduate years explicitly allowed, e.g. `[1, 2, 3, 4]`. null when the listing doesn't say. |
| `eligibility.graduate_students` | boolean or null |  | true when it is a graduate-student group. null when not stated. |
| `time_commitment` | object |  | Expected hours per week. |
| `time_commitment.hours_per_week_min` | number or null |  | Fewest hours per week expected. A single figure ("about 4 hours") sets min and max to the same number. |
| `time_commitment.hours_per_week_max` | number or null |  | Most hours per week expected. null while min is set means "at least min". |
| `meetings` | object |  | How often it meets. |
| `meetings.per_week` | number or null |  | Meetings per week as a number: 0.25 monthly, 0.5 every two weeks, 1 weekly, 2 twice a week, and so on. |
| `meetings.frequency` | string or null |  | `per_week` as a label: `monthly`, `biweekly`, `weekly`, `2x-weekly`, `3x-weekly`, `4x-weekly`, `daily`. |
| `tags` | array of strings |  | Lowercase topic tags: the directory's own categories, the type, the subfaculty, and keyword tags (robotics, finance…). Every tag is listed in `tags.json`. |
| `description` | string |  | The activity's own short description from its listing. Empty when none was published. |
| `listing_url` | string |  | The original listing this record came from: the page to check before relying on it. |
| `apply_url` | string or null |  | Where to apply or learn more: an open posting if there is one, otherwise the activity's website. |
| `links` | object |  | Public links for the activity. |
| `links.website` | string or null |  | The activity's own website or link page (Linktree etc.). |
| `links.instagram` | string or null |  | Instagram profile URL, normalised to `https://www.instagram.com/<handle>/`. |
| `source` | object |  | The directory this record was collected from. |
| `source.id` | string |  | Source id, e.g. `queens-engsoc`. Every source is listed in info.json under `sources`. |
| `source.name` | string |  | Human-readable name of the directory. |
| `source.url` | string |  | The directory's main page. |
| `also_listed_in` | array of objects |  | Other directories that list the same activity. It's returned once, with the more specific listing as the main one. |
| `also_listed_in[].source` | object |  | The other directory. |
| `also_listed_in[].source.id` | string |  | Source id, e.g. `queens-engsoc`. Every source is listed in info.json under `sources`. |
| `also_listed_in[].source.name` | string |  | Human-readable name of the directory. |
| `also_listed_in[].source.url` | string |  | The directory's main page. |
| `also_listed_in[].name` | string |  | The name used in that directory (may differ slightly). |
| `also_listed_in[].listing_url` | string |  | The listing in that directory. |
| `source_updated_at` | string or null |  | When the source last changed this listing, if it says. |
| `provenance` | object |  | For each field not copied directly from the listing, how its value was decided. Keyed by field path, e.g. `eligibility.first_year`, `meetings`, `applications_open`. |
| `provenance.<field>.method` | string | `source`, `inferred`, `derived`, `override` | How that field's value was decided (see the table below). |
| `provenance.<field>.evidence` | string or null |  | Why: the matched listing text, the recruitment posting, or the maintainer's note. |

## `null` means unknown

Most directories don't list hours, meeting times or application windows, so many of those
fields are `null`. A value is never guessed to fill a gap.

## `provenance.<field>.method`

| Method | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `source` | Stated by an official source, e.g. an active recruitment posting. |
| `inferred` | Read from the listing's own text by a fixed rule. `evidence` quotes the words that matched. |
| `derived` | Follows from which directory the activity was listed in (e.g. EngSoc means faculty `engineering`). |
| `override` | Checked and set by a maintainer. `evidence` says where the information came from. |

Fields with no `provenance` entry were copied straight from the listing.

## Tags

`tags` combines:

- the directory's own categories, lowercased and hyphenated (e.g. AMS "Science & Engineering" becomes `science-engineering`);
- the activity's `type` and `subfaculty`;
- keyword tags matched from the name and description: `advocacy`, `aerospace`, `ai`, `automotive`, `biomedical`, `competition`, `cultural`, `dance`, `debate`, `entrepreneurship`, `equity`, `faith`, `finance`, `gaming`, `music`, `networking`, `outdoors`, `outreach`, `research`, `robotics`, `software`, `sustainability`, `theatre`, `volunteering`, `writing`.

The full live list with counts is at `v1/{school}/tags.json`.

## Machine-readable

The same fields, with exact JSON types, are recorded in
[`contracts/v1.json`](../contracts/v1.json). Within v1, fields are only ever added, never removed or
changed in type (see [versions.md](versions.md)).
